svg.title: Where the lightning fell
svg.desc: Every flash of a synthetic year, accumulated one day at a time — 253,313 points binned to 120 by 50 cells. Covering 125.0°W to 67.0°W, 25.0°N to 49.0°N. Contiguous United States is the mapped area.
